title: Halloween
summary: The season event: dark clouds over the city, the season's grounds with the Haunted Castle dungeon, candies, and Grimble's Candy Bazaar: three chests (SP gear, cosmetics) or a direct buy of a prize (chest price / chance x 1.25), and the title Halloween 2026 (2,500 candies).
